components.html:

components.css: .ds-panel { min-height: 320px; padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem 1.35rem; color: var(--ink, #F4F7FA); border: 1px solid var(--line, #2B323B); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--panel, #14171C); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); } .ds-panel-label { color: var(--muted, #97A3B4); font: 700 0.66rem/1.3 'Public Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0.45rem 0 0.35rem; color: var(--ink, #F4F7FA); font: 600 1.05rem/1.3 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-panel-copy { max-width: 60ch; margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #C8D2DE); font: 400 0.94rem/1.72 'Public Sans', sans-serif; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: The compact light/dark control in the topbar.
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { display: inline-flex; min-height: 34px; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.34rem 0.72rem; color: var(--ink-soft, #C8D2DE); border: 1px solid var(--line, #2B323B); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel-2, #191E24); font: 500 0.75rem/1 'Public Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #3D4653); background: var(--panel-3, #20262E); } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #7AA2FF); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Suggested Question
components.description: A full-width question row that submits through the real chat pipeline.
components.css: .ds-suggestion { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.76rem 0.9rem; color: var(--ink-soft, #C8D2DE); border: 1px solid var(--line, #2B323B); border-radius: 13px; background: var(--panel-2, #191E24); font: 500 0.85rem/1.45 'Public Sans', sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-suggestion:hover { color: var(--ink, #F4F7FA); border-color: var(--line-strong, #3D4653); background: var(--panel-3, #20262E); } .ds-suggestion:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #7AA2FF); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-arrow { flex: none; width: 13px; height: 13px; border-top: 2px solid currentColor; border-right: 2px solid currentColor; transform: rotate(45deg); }

components.name: Source Ledger Row
components.description: A 44px disclosure over one real retrieved passage.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-source { border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #2B323B); } .ds-source summary { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; padding: 0.6rem 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #C8D2DE); font: 500 0.78rem/1.4 'Public Sans', sans-serif; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-source summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-source summary:hover { color: var(--blue, #7AA2FF); } .ds-source summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #7AA2FF); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-source-index { display: grid; flex: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; place-items: center; color: var(--blue, #7AA2FF); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--blue-soft, #18243A); font: 600 0.64rem/1 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-source-label { min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-source-chevron { flex: none; width: 11px; height: 11px; border-right: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 1.5px solid currentColor; transform: rotate(45deg); transition: transform 150ms ease; } .ds-source[open] .ds-source-chevron { transform: rotate(225deg); } .ds-source-excerpt { margin: 0.2rem 0 0.7rem; padding-left: 1.65rem; color: var(--ink-soft, #C8D2DE); font: 400 0.82rem/1.55 'Public Sans', sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Real index state with a semantic dot and a readable label.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; padding: 0.24rem 0.6rem; color: var(--success, #71D6A1); border: 1px solid var(--success-line, #265039); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--success-soft, #12251A); font: 600 0.66rem/1.2 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Primary Build Button
components.description: The one filled-blue action, used when the index must be built.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0.48rem 0.8rem; color: var(--on-blue, #0A1224); border: 1px solid var(--blue, #7AA2FF); border-radius: 13px; background: var(--blue, #7AA2FF); font: 600 0.8rem/1 'Public Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-primary:hover { border-color: var(--blue-deep, #A8C0FF); background: var(--blue-deep, #A8C0FF); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #7AA2FF); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Composer
components.description: The anchored chat field with a quiet raised surface.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #2B323B); border-radius: 13px; background: var(--panel-2, #191E24); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; color: var(--ink, #F4F7FA); border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; font: 400 0.9rem/1.5 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #97A3B4); opacity: 1; } .ds-field:focus-within { border-color: var(--blue, #7AA2FF); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--blue-tint, #253A5A), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
The handbook is the room, the conversation is the desk, and the evidence is kept in plain sight. Graphite panels sit on a quiet field with hairline seams; academic blue appears only where the user can act or where a citation needs attention. The tone is calm, exact, and deliberately unadorned: this is a reference tool, not a study dashboard.

The layout carries that idea as three working surfaces: a reference rail, a central conversation, and a study rail limited to real session counts, citations, and index maintenance. The interface should feel like one continuous desk rather than a collection of cards. Light mode is a cool-paper counterpart, not a washed-out dark mode.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first graphite shell with an equally intentional cool-paper light mode.
Numbered evidence ledger rows instead of citation chips or generated summaries.
Compact pill controls, hairline borders, and soft tonal depth.
Serif display voice reserved for the handbook welcome and sidebar document name.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Academic blue marks actions, links, citations, and focus. It never becomes a decorative wash or a second brand color.

rules.name: The Two-Room Rule
rules.body: Dark and light are separate rooms with the same furniture. Every surface, state, and control must be designed in both; a light theme that merely inverts the dark one is unfinished.

rules.name: The Serif Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Literata belongs to the handbook and the welcome. Controls, counts, citations, and error copy stay in Public Sans.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: If a border can explain the boundary, do not add a shadow. If a shadow can explain the lift, do not add a second border.

dos: Do keep the evidence ledger tied to backend metadata and real excerpts.
Do design every state in both themes: empty, loading, abstention, error, stale index, missing document.
Do keep controls at least 44px where the control is a primary touch target, and always preserve the 3px blue focus ring.
Do reserve Literata for the welcome and the sidebar document name.
Do use real session counts and working actions in the study rail.
donts: Don't add audio, video, quiz, flashcard, or note-generation tools that the backend cannot produce.
Don't turn the study rail into a dashboard of decorative metrics.
Don't use colored left borders, gradient text, glass panels, or nested cards.
Don't invent citations, page numbers, or document status.
Don't make the light theme a simple inversion of the dark one.
